DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コピー機のところからお呼びでしたね。どのような状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You called from the copier, correct? What is happening?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 両面コピーをしたら、裏だけ上下が逆になりました。もう一度コピーする前に設定を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 両面コピーの裏が上下逆で再印刷前に設定を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I made a double-sided copy, only the back came out upside down. I'd like to check the settings before copying again.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the back of the double-sided copy is upside down and you want to check the settings before printing again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 機械の案内を一緒に確認します。原稿は縦向きですか、横向きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the machine's guidance together. Are the originals portrait or landscape?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 縦向きの原稿が二枚です。本のように横へめくって読める仕上がりにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 縦向き二枚を本のように横にめくれる形にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two portrait originals. I'd like the finished copy to read by turning pages sideways like a book.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want two portrait pages in a format that turns sideways like a book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面の仕上がり図を見て、とじる側を選びましょう。個人情報の内容は見ずに操作の表示をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look at the finishing diagram on the screen and choose the binding side. I'll guide you through the controls without looking at your personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この図では左側がとじる位置ですね。まず一部だけ試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左側をとじる図だと確認し一部だけ試したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. This diagram shows the binding on the left, right? I'd like to try just one copy first.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the diagram has left-side binding and ask to try just one copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部数を一にしたことを確認してください。料金を入れる前に、用紙と両面の設定も見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the number of copies is set to one. Before inserting money, let's review the paper and double-sided settings too.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部数は一、用紙はＡ四です。二枚の原稿を読み込んだ後に、追加するか聞かれたら終了を選びますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部数一とＡ四を確認し二枚読込み後は終了を選ぶか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: One copy and A4 paper. After scanning the two originals, if it asks whether to add more, should I select finish?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm one copy and A4, and ask whether to select finish after scanning the two pages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追加の原稿がなければ、表示の説明に従って終了を選んでください。印刷前の確認画面まで進めてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have no more originals, follow the onscreen explanation and select finish. Let's go as far as the confirmation screen before printing.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認画面で向きを見ます。正しくできたら残りをコピーし、最後に原稿を回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 向きを確認してから残りをコピーし最後に原稿を回収すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the orientation on the confirmation screen. If it is correct, I'll copy the rest and collect my originals at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the orientation, copy the rest, and collect the originals at the end. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 機械のそばで操作を見守りますね。原稿とお釣りの取り忘れにご注意ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll stay by the machine to watch the operation. Please remember your originals and change. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人でご相談でしょうか。今日はどなたのお手続きについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the two of you here for a consultation? Whose procedure is it about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母の手続きです。母はここにいますが、日本語で説明するのが難しいので、私が質問を整理して話してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母が同席しているが日本語の説明が難しいため質問を整理して話したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's my mother's procedure. She's here, but explaining in Japanese is difficult, so may I organize the questions and speak?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother is present but finds Japanese explanation difficult, and ask to organize the questions and speak. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一般的な案内はご一緒にお聞きいただけます。本人に確認が必要な点は、お母さまにも伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can hear general guidance together. We'll also ask your mother about anything that requires confirmation from her.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。母に伝えながら進めます。今日は必要な書類を知りたいだけで、申請はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母に伝えながら進め今日は申請せず必要書類だけ知りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll explain it to her as we go. Today we only want to know the required documents; we're not applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you will keep your mother informed and only want document requirements today, without applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何の手続きについて、書類を確認したいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: What procedure would you like to check the documents for?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 引っ越しの後の住所の手続きです。古い住所と新しい住所を書いたメモを持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引越し後の住所の手続きで新旧住所のメモがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Address procedures after moving. I've brought a note with the old and new addresses.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it concerns address procedures after moving and you have a note of the old and new addresses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず状況を伺って、該当する手続きの案内をお渡しします。メモはお手元で見ながら説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll first ask about the situation, then give you guidance for the applicable procedure. Please explain while looking at your note yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母が答える必要のある質問は、短く区切っていただけますか。私から母に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人への質問は短く区切り母に確認しながら答えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you break questions my mother needs to answer into short parts? I'll check with her.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for short questions to the applicant so you can check with your mother while answering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一項目ずつ伺いますね。代理で申請する場合の条件は、一般案内と区別して確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask one item at a time. Let's check the conditions for an application by a representative separately from general guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は本人と一緒に必要書類を確かめ、代理申請の可否は決めずに持ち帰って検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母と必要書類を確認し代理申請の可否は持ち帰って検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll confirm the required documents together with my mother. We won't decide whether an application by a representative is possible; we'll take the information home and consider it.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the documents with your mother and consider representative application at home without deciding now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、最初にお引っ越しの状況から伺います。書類を整える際もご相談ください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll start by asking about the move. Please ask us when preparing the documents too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記入中の用紙について、ご質問があるようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: It looks like you have a question about the form you're filling in.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい住所を書くところで困っています。手元のメモにある郵便番号が、住所の検索結果と違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所のメモの郵便番号が検索結果と異なり記入に困っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm having trouble with the new-address section. The postcode on my note differs from the address search result.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the postcode in your new-address note differs from the search result and you are having trouble filling it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず住所の文字を確かめましょう。メモと契約書では、同じ住所になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's first check the address text. Is the address the same on the note and the contract?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 町名と番地は同じです。でも、メモの郵便番号は引っ越す前に友人から聞いたものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 町名と番地は契約書と同じだが郵便番号は友人に聞いたものと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The town name and street number are the same. But the postcode on the note is one a friend told me before I moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the town and street numbers match the contract, but the postcode came from a friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認前の番号を書かず、住所に対応する番号を調べましょう。契約書をお持ちでしたら、表記を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't write an unconfirmed number. Let's look up the number matching the address. If you have the contract, compare the wording.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約書は携帯の画像で持っています。部屋番号も含めて、こちらの案内で郵便番号を調べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯の契約書画像を使い部屋番号も含めて番号を調べられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an image of the contract on my phone. Can I use this guidance to look up the postcode, including the room number?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the contract image on your phone to search for the postcode including the room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所検索の方法をご案内します。部屋番号の欄は別にあるので、番号を調べた後に記入を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you how to search by address. There is a separate room-number field, so let's check the entries after looking up the postcode.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 検索で見つかりました。友人のメモは隣の町の番号だったので、このメモを直しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検索で友人のメモが隣町の番号と分かりメモを修正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I found it in the search. My friend's note had the neighboring town's postcode, so I'll correct the note.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the search showed your friend's note had the neighboring town's postcode and you will correct it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食い違いが分かってよかったです。記入後、転居の扱いと必要な確認事項をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'm glad we found the mismatch. After you fill it in, we'll explain how the move is handled and the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新住所の番号を書き直します。用紙を出す前に、番地と部屋番号が抜けていないかも見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新住所の番号を書き直し提出前に番地と部屋番号の抜けを確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll rewrite the new address's postcode. Before submitting the form, I'd also like you to check that the street and room numbers haven't been omitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Rewrite the new postcode and ask them to check for missing street and room numbers before submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 完成した用紙をお持ちください。確認してから受付をご案内します。それでは、お帰りもどうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring the completed form. We'll check it and then guide you through reception. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 両替をご希望ですね。金額と、ご希望の内訳は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to change money, correct? Have you decided the amount and denominations?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: イベントの釣銭用に一万円を崩したいです。百円玉を多めにしたいのですが、内訳を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: イベントの釣銭として一万円を崩し百円玉を多めにしたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to break ten thousand yen for change at an event. I'd prefer more hundred-yen coins. Can we discuss the breakdown?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to break ten thousand yen for event change with more hundred-yen coins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望を伺い、取り扱いと手数料を確認します。百円玉以外には何が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll hear your wishes and check the service and fees. What do you need besides hundred-yen coins?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五百円玉を十枚と、残りを百円玉にしたいです。これで合計一万円になりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五百円玉十枚と残りを百円玉にして一万円になるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like ten five-hundred-yen coins and the rest in hundred-yen coins. That totals ten thousand yen, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm ten five-hundred-yen coins and the rest in hundred-yen coins total ten thousand yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 五百円玉が五千円、百円玉が五十枚で五千円ですね。枚数をもとに、利用条件も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The five-hundred-yen coins are five thousand yen, and fifty hundred-yen coins make five thousand yen. We'll check the service conditions based on the number of pieces too.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その内訳でお願いします。ただ、手数料が予算を超える場合は、百円玉を減らして千円札に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手数料が予算を超えれば百円玉を減らして千円札に変えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: That breakdown, please. But if the fee exceeds my budget, I'd like fewer hundred-yen coins and thousand-yen notes instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want fewer hundred-yen coins and thousand-yen notes instead if the fee exceeds your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更する場合の枚数も確認しましょう。手数料の案内を見てから、最終的な内訳をご指定ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also check the piece count if you change it. Please choose the final breakdown after seeing the fee information.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、申込書はまだ出さずにおきます。この口座のカードを持っていることも、条件の確認に必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申込書を保留し口座カードの有無も利用条件の確認に必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't submit the application yet. Do you also need to know that I have the card for this account to check the service conditions?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold off submitting the form and ask whether having the account card is needed to check conditions too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードの有無を含めて、適用される取り扱いを確認します。カードはお手元に置き、必要になったらお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check what applies, including whether you have a card. Keep the card with you and show it if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、まず手数料を聞きます。その金額でよければ、五百円玉十枚と百円玉五十枚で申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手数料を聞いて納得した場合に五百円玉十枚と百円玉五十枚を申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll ask the fee first. If I'm satisfied with that amount, I'll apply for ten five-hundred-yen coins and fifty hundred-yen coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the fee and request ten five-hundred-yen and fifty hundred-yen coins only if you accept it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内訳と費用が決まってからお手続きを進めます。釣銭は受取時にもお確かめください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll proceed after the breakdown and cost are decided. Please check the change when you receive it too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図を見ていらっしゃいますね。どの辺りを歩くご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the map. Which area do you plan to walk around?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 石垣を見ながら歩きたいです。持ってきた古い地図では道が続いていますが、掲示では途中に線が引かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 石垣を見たいが古い地図と掲示の道の表示が違うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to walk while looking at the stone walls. The old map I brought shows a continuous path, but the posted notice has a line across it partway along.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you want to see the stone walls but the old map and posted path markings differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 地図の発行時期と、掲示の位置を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the map's publication date and where on the notice you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図は五年前のもので、この掲示の赤い線です。通れない場所なのか、ただの区切りなのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五年前の地図と掲示の赤線を示し通行禁止か区切りか分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The map is from five years ago. I mean this red line on the notice. I don't know whether it marks a closed section or just a boundary.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the five-year-old map and red line and explain you don't know if it means no passage or a boundary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 赤い線の意味を管理担当に確認します。分からないままその道に入らず、今開放されている範囲を選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask management what the red line means. Don't enter that path while it's unclear; let's choose the area currently open.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認が済むまでは、入口から見える石垣だけ見ます。あの柵の内側に入らずに見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認までは入口から石垣を見て柵の外側から見られるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Until that is checked, I'll just view the stone walls visible from the entrance. Can I see them without going inside that fence?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Until checked, view the walls from the entrance and ask whether you can see them from outside the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 柵の外側の園路からご覧ください。足元の段差にもご注意ください。撮影の際は園路を塞がないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look from the park path outside the fence. Watch the uneven ground too. When taking photos, please don't block the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三脚は持っていません。立ち止まる場所を少し端へずらして、通る人を先に通します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三脚はなく端で立ち止まり通る人を先に通すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't have a tripod. I'll move a little to the edge when stopping and let people pass first.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have no tripod, will stop at the edge, and let people pass first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。古い地図には今回確認した情報を書き込んでおくと、後で混同しにくいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Writing the newly checked information on the old map can help avoid confusion later.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。赤い線の道はまだ入らないとメモして、今日の掲示を優先して歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認の道に入らないとメモし現在の掲示を優先して歩くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll do that. I'll note not to enter the red-line path yet and walk according to today's notices first.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note not to enter the unchecked path and say you will follow the current notices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の掲示をご確認いただければ助かります。城跡の散策を楽しんでください。それでは、足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking the current notices. Enjoy walking around the castle ruins, and watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体験のご案内をご覧になっていますか。参加人数を伺ってもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the activity information? May I ask how many participants?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人です。最初は踊るつもりでしたが、友人が足を休めたいので、二人とも見学に変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で踊る予定だったが友人が足を休めたいので見学へ変えたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two. We first planned to dance, but my friend wants to rest their legs. Can both of us switch to observing?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you both planned to dance but want to switch to observing because your friend wants to rest their legs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付前でしたら、ご希望に合う案内を確認します。すでに参加券を購入されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you haven't registered yet, we'll check guidance that fits your wishes. Have you already bought participation tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 券はまだ買っていません。友人は立ち続けるのがつらいので、座って見られる方法を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券は未購入で友人が座って見られる方法を探していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: We haven't bought tickets yet. My friend finds it hard to keep standing, so we're looking for a way to watch while seated.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you haven't bought tickets and are looking for a way for your friend to watch seated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 座席を利用する見学の案内があるか、担当に確認しましょう。体験への参加は無理に決めなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the staff whether there is an observation option with seats. You don't have to force yourselves to decide to join the activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。踊らなくても、手の動きなどの説明を聞けると嬉しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 踊らなくても手の動きの説明を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Even without dancing, I'd be happy to hear explanations of the hand movements and things like that.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you would like explanations of the hand movements even without dancing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見学の内容と座席の状況を確認してお伝えします。お待ちの間、友人の方はこちらでお休みになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the observation content and seat availability and let you know. While waiting, would your friend like to rest here?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人をここへ呼びます。私だけ先に申し込まず、二人で説明を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人を呼び二人で説明を聞いてから申込を決めたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll call my friend over. Rather than apply by myself first, I'd like us both to hear the explanation before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will call your friend and decide whether to apply after both hear the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。お二人で確認してからお選びください。席が利用できない場合の予定も考えておかれるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please choose after both of you check. It would also be good to consider a plan if seats aren't available.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その場合は今日は展示だけ見ます。見学できる席と内容を確認してから、友人と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席が利用できなければ展示だけ見て座席と内容確認後に友人と相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: In that case, we'll just see the exhibits today. I'll check the seats and observation content and then discuss it with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will only see exhibits if seats are unavailable and consult your friend after checking seats and content. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、案内を確認してきます。無理のない楽しみ方をお選びください。それでは、どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check the information. Please choose a way to enjoy yourselves without strain. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 風が強くなってきましたね。お持ち物は大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: The wind is getting stronger. Are your belongings all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帽子が飛びそうです。参拝する間だけ、入口の台の上に置いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風で飛びそうな帽子を参拝中に入口の台へ置いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: My hat looks as though it might blow away. May I leave it on the stand at the entrance just while I worship?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave your hat, which looks likely to blow away in the wind, on the stand at the entrance while you worship. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その台は案内用ですので、物を置かずにお願いします。帽子はご自分の袋にしまえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: That stand is for information, so please do not put anything on it. Can you put your hat in your own bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さな袋しかなくて入りません。手に持ったままお参りしても失礼になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋に帽子が入らず手に持ったまま参拝してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only have a small bag, and it will not fit. Would it be disrespectful to worship while holding it in my hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your hat does not fit in your bag and ask whether you may worship while holding it in your hand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手荷物の扱いをご案内します。無理に台へ置かず、帽子は落とさないようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me explain how to handle your belongings. Please do not try to put it on the stand; hold your hat carefully so that you do not drop it.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、左手で持ちます。人が並んでいるあの場所が参拝の入口ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帽子を左手に持つと伝え人が並ぶ場所が入口か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will hold it in my left hand. Is that place where people are lining up the entrance for worship?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will hold your hat in your left hand and ask whether the place where people are lining up is the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口は列の先です。前の方が進んでから順にお入りください。敷居のところで立ち止まらないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: The entrance is at the front of the line. Please enter in order after the person ahead of you moves forward. Please do not stop on the threshold.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 急がず順番を待ちます。参拝が終わったら、同じ入口から戻るのか、横へ出るのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 順番を待つと伝え参拝後は入口へ戻るか横へ出るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait my turn without rushing. I am unsure whether I should return through the same entrance or leave to the side after worshipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait your turn and ask whether to return to the entrance or leave to the side after worshipping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口の表示に従って横の通路へお進みください。分からない場合は、近くの係にお声をおかけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the exit signs into the passage at the side. If you are unsure, please ask a nearby attendant.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帽子を持って列に並び、終わったら横の出口表示を見ます。途中で困ったら係の方に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帽子を持って並び出口表示を見て不明なら係へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will join the line holding my hat and look for the exit sign at the side when I am finished. If I have any difficulty along the way, I will ask an attendant.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will line up holding your hat, look for the exit sign, and ask an attendant if you are unsure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、順にお進みください。お帰りの際も風にお気をつけて。よいお参りになりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed in order, then. Be careful of the wind on your way home as well. I hope you have a good visit for worship.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車についてのご相談ですね。なくなったことに気づいた状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to speak to us about your bicycle. Please tell me the circumstances in which you noticed it was missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅の近くに止めた自転車がありません。近くで工事をしていて、移されたのか盗まれたのか分からないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅付近の自転車がなく工事で移動されたのか盗難か分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bicycle I parked near the station is missing. There is construction work nearby, and I do not know whether it was moved or stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your bicycle near the station is missing and that you do not know whether it was moved because of construction work or stolen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 止めた場所と時刻、戻った時刻を順に伺います。現場に移動先の掲示はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask you in order where and when you parked it, and when you returned. Was there a notice at the site saying where bicycles had been moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝八時に止め、昼一時に戻りました。柵の外から見ましたが、移動先の掲示は見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八時に駐輪し一時に戻り柵の外から移動先の掲示が見つからなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I parked it at eight in the morning and returned at one in the afternoon. I looked from outside the fence, but I could not find a notice saying where it had been moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you parked at eight, returned at one, and could not find a notice about where it had been moved when you looked from outside the fence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。盗難と決めつけず、まず分かっている事実を記録しましょう。自転車の特徴は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand. Rather than assume it was stolen, let us first record the facts we know. Do you remember the bicycle's distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、前かごに黒いカバーがあります。登録番号の写真は携帯に残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀色で黒いかごカバーがあり登録番号の写真も残っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is silver, with a black cover on the front basket. I still have a photo of its registration number on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it is silver, has a black basket cover, and that you still have a photo of its registration number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その写真も確認させてください。鍵を掛けたかどうかと、工事関係者に聞いたかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let me check that photo as well. Please also tell me whether you locked it and whether you have asked anyone involved in the construction work.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵は掛けました。作業している人にはまだ聞いていません。危ないので工事の中には入りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施錠済みだが作業者には聞かず危険なので現場に入っていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I locked it. I have not asked the people working there yet. I did not enter the construction site because it was dangerous.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you locked it, have not asked the workers, and did not enter the site because it was dangerous. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中へ入らなかったのは適切です。確認先をご案内しますので、勝手に現場へ入らず、担当者を通して確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: It was appropriate not to enter. I will tell you whom to contact, so please do not enter the site on your own; let us check through the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、登録番号の写真をお見せします。確認先を聞いて、移動された記録があるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録番号の写真を示し移動記録を確かめるため確認先を教えてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will show you the photo of the registration number. I would like to find out whom to contact and check whether there is a record of it being moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the photo of the registration number and ask whom to contact to check for a record of the bicycle being moved. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真と場所の説明を合わせて伺います。安全な所から確認してください。それでは、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will look at the photo and hear your explanation of the location together. Please make your inquiries from a safe place. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤の詰め替えをお探しですね。お使いの商品の名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for a detergent refill. Do you know the name of the product you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 容器の写真を撮ってきました。この詰め替えは似ていますが、香りの名前が違います。同じ容器に入れてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 容器の写真と香り名が違う詰め替えを同じ容器へ入れてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took a photo of the container. This refill looks similar, but the fragrance has a different name. May I put it in the same container?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the photo of the container and ask whether a refill with a different fragrance name may be put in the same container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の商品名と、詰め替えの表示を見比べましょう。中に前の洗剤は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the product name in the photo with the label on the refill. Is there any of the old detergent left inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 底に少し残っています。違う種類を足して混ぜることになるなら、買うのをやめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 底に洗剤が残り違う種類を混ぜるなら購入をやめたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a little left at the bottom. If adding this would mean mixing different types, I would rather not buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there is detergent left at the bottom and that you would rather not buy the refill if it means mixing different types. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示に同じ商品専用と書かれていますね。別の種類は混ぜず、メーカーの注意書きを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: The label says it is only for refilling the same product. Do not mix different types, and please check the manufacturer's precautions.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、写真と同じ商品の詰め替えが棚にあるか探していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真と同じ商品の詰め替えが棚にあるか探してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then could you look for a refill of the same product as in the photo on the shelves?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to look on the shelves for a refill of the same product as in the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この棚には見当たりません。在庫を確認しますが、今日すぐ必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I do not see it on this shelf. I will check our stock, but do you need it straight away today?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日洗濯したいです。在庫がなければ、新しい本体を一つ買って、古い物と分けて使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日洗濯したく在庫がなければ本体を買い古い洗剤と分けて使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to do laundry today. If you have none in stock, I will buy one new bottle and use it separately from the old detergent.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to do laundry today and, if the refill is out of stock, will buy a new bottle and use it separately from the old detergent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本体を選ぶ場合も用途と注意書きをご確認ください。こちらに洗濯用の売場があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: When choosing a new bottle as well, please check its intended use and precautions. The laundry detergent section is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この本体にします。古い容器へ移さず、買った容器のまま使い、表示を読んで量を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新しい本体を選び移し替えず表示に従って量を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take this bottle. I will use it in the container I buy, without transferring it into the old one, and read the label to decide how much to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a new bottle and say that you will not transfer its contents and will follow the label to decide how much to use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 別々に使う形ですね。表示をご確認のうえお使いください。お買い物ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: So you will use them separately. Please check the labels before use. Thank you for shopping with us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お取り置きの商品を受け取りにいらっしゃったのですね。お名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have come to collect the item we set aside for you. May I have your name, please?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: チャンです。電話で青いシャツを取り置いてもらいましたが、この照明だと紫に見えるので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: チャンの取り置きシャツが照明で紫に見え電話で頼んだ青か確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is Chan. I asked you over the phone to hold a blue shirt for me, but it looks purple under this lighting, so I would like to check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are Chan, that the reserved shirt looks purple under the lighting, and that you want to check whether it is the blue one you requested over the phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お取り置きの記録と商品のタグを見比べます。電話では品番もお伝えいただきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will compare the reservation record with the product tag. Did you also give us the product number over the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 品番は伝えず、写真にある青い方と言いました。この写真を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 品番を伝えず写真の青を指定したと説明して写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not give a product number; I said the blue one in the photo. Could you look at this photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not give a product number but specified the blue one in the photo, and show the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します。写真の色は画面によって見え方が変わるので、品番と色名の表示も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me take a look. Colors in a photo can look different depending on the screen, so let us also check the product number and the color name on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: タグの色名は紺になっていますね。私が欲しかったのは、隣に写っている明るい青の方かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: タグが紺で希望は写真に写った明るい青かもしれないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: The color name on the tag is navy, I see. Perhaps the one I wanted was the bright blue one shown next to it in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the tag says navy and that you may have wanted the bright blue one shown in the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 明るい青の同じサイズがあるか調べます。お取り置きの分は、購入前ですので一度お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check whether we have the bright blue one in the same size. Please wait a moment regarding the reserved one, since you have not purchased it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その色があれば、二枚を並べて見たいです。写真だけで決めず、実物の色を比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じサイズの二色を並べて写真ではなく実物で比べたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: If you have that color, I would like to see the two shirts side by side. I will compare their actual colors rather than decide just from the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to see the two colors in the same size side by side and compare the actual shirts instead of their photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明るい青をご用意できました。こちらの確認用の場所で並べてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have the bright blue one ready. Please look at them side by side here in the area for checking items.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 比べると明るい青が希望の色です。取り置いた紺は買わず、この青を購入したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取り置きの紺ではなく希望に合う明るい青を購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Comparing them, the bright blue is the color I wanted. I would like to buy this blue one instead of the navy one you held for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to buy the bright blue one that matches your wishes instead of the reserved navy one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご希望の青で承ります。次回は品番もお伝えいただけると確認しやすくなります。それでは、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will ring up the blue one you wanted. Next time, giving us the product number as well will make it easier to check. Thank you very much.
